regime_context: Hong Kong shows a narrow, one-narrative rotation: Banks (H + HK) is the sole leader (rank 1, eligible, durability 0.56, not crowded) absorbing 48% of flows, with only 2 of 17 themes trend-eligible and a modest margin (0.208) over challenger Energy. However, the leader is unscorable (no ETF proxy), the only scorable names (China Tech & Internet and China Platform Megacaps via 3033.HK) rank 13 and 15 with negative scores, and macro backdrop is 100% unscheduled surprises — so I can only express the dominant structure as a conditional on the benchmark, not on any priced instrument.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Energy (H-shares) crosses into eligible status while Banks' durability_bar comes back toward 0.5 — a confirmed handoff condition, not a call. I retire this watch if Energy stays ineligible for 10 consecutive sessions while Banks remains the one-narrative leader.

theses.subject: Banks (H + HK)
theses.thesis: Banks is the confirmed one-narrative leader: rank 1, the only theme with a durability bar above 0.5, eligible on the absolute-trend gate (the one validated risk-control leg), and rotation breadth is narrow (0.12) meaning money is concentrating rather than dispersing. Uncrowded (z 0.62 below threshold). Lean is expressed against the Hang Seng as a relative direction, not a forecast of absolute return — supported by the trend-gate, not by rank alpha.
